semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides critical infrastructure components and services that support semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
summary: Third Enterprise Co., Ltd. specializes in the distribution and sales of UL and IEC certified equipment for semiconductor facilities, including Busway systems, breakers, and transformers. They offer comprehensive services in factory electromechanical design, power management analysis, and system construction, ensuring compliance with international standards.
capabilities: Distribution of SQ-D Busway systems and Busway Plug-in Units
Sales of ASCO Automatic Transfer Switches and Current Transfer Switches
Customized assembly of low-voltage AC/DC distribution panels
Integration of smart meters and management software for energy distribution
